name: accountable-agent
description: Give an AI agent on Hedera a human guardian, a verifiable identity and guardian-approved spending rules, set up in the browser, with signed standing sold over x402.

steps.text: Starts the dashboard (:3000), the standing API (:3001) and the local agent runtime (:3002). Missing local keys are generated into ignored .env files and never printed.

sections.title: 2. Set up your agent in the browser

steps.text: Connect HashPack with an ECDSA testnet account holding about 50 HBAR; it becomes the guardian. Approve four transactions: fund the setup account, create the HCS topic, allow the spend asset, approve the agreement. The agent runtime does the rest.
The dashboard switches from the synthetic demo to live testnet data: your agent's 1-of-2 account, HCS profile, ERC-8004 identity, guardian controls and paid standing at /standing/:id.

steps.label: Guide, CLI setup and testnet evidence
